note: Per-URL content hash and the date that content last changed. A page's lastmod is the date its visible text last changed in a commit that did not change more than 10% of the published library at once; where that never happened, it is the date the page was added. Reseeded from real git history by scripts/reseed_lastmod_from_git.py - no date here was reconstructed or invented. lastmod only advances for a URL whose hash changed; see scripts/lib/lastmod_ledger.py.
